description: A stark, mathematically perfect cube of seamless pale-gray material. The walls, floor, and ceiling are utterly featureless, with no doors, windows, or adornments. Yet the ceiling glows with a soft, even, warm light that fills every corner with gentle illumination. The air is fresh and pleasantly warm, carrying a faint scent of clean linen. The silence is absolute, so thick you can hear your own heartbeat.

items.name: Panel 4
items.description:
PANEL. Welcome to Task 4. Remain in this room.

A table holds several items. For each item, state its position relative to the table out loud.

items.name: table
items.description: A long table set for a meal that never came. Seven place settings — one for each family member. One place setting at the head of the table is disturbed, the chair pushed back as if someone left in a hurry. The plate is cracked.

name: Task 4
